sanskrit:
यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः ।
क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम् ॥ १८-२४॥
iast:
yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṅkāreṇa vā punaḥ
kriyate bahulāyāsaṃ tadrājasamudāhṛtam 18-24
translation: But that action which is done by one longing for desires or gain done with egoism or with much effort is declared to be RAJASIC (Passionate) .
